## Layer `Guidance`

This directory contains the `Guidance` layer. Guidance is the analyzer the guidance package exports: the pack's build-decidable rules as a model it embeds, each reported under an ID of its own by the build analyzer's engine. Its architecture rules:

- `layering/guidance-builds-on-the-engine-only` — The Guidance layer must reference only the Core layer, the Extraction layer or the Analyzers layer (external packages are not constrained by this rule). The guidance package is one assembly: its build compiles Core, Extraction and the build analyzer's engine in from their own directories, and nothing else. A reference to any other project here resolves in the editor and in every tool that reads this repository, and then names a type the shipped assembly does not contain, so the analyzer fails to load inside the compiler of everyone who references the package.
- Expand any rule above with `sliderule explain <rule-id>`.
